result.summary: The landlord is arranging the rat treatment and proofing himself, and the proofing has stalled. Pest control finished on 7 Sept, but the proofing contractor didn't turn up on 8 Sept, and two waiting periods have passed with no word from the landlord. I emailed the landlord asking for the contractor's name, a new date and the pest report. I texted the tenant an update and placed a 2-day hold. I also escalated to the human queue at normal priority, recommending a phone call to the landlord, because the deadlines have passed twice, the tenant sounds unhappy and there's a health risk.
result.situation: Rats are getting into the kitchen, including under the sink, at 14 Mosswold Crescent. On 18 Aug the landlord took on the works himself. Pest control's final visit was 7 Sept. Sealing the openings is still outstanding: the expected contractor didn't attend on 8 Sept, and nothing has been confirmed since. The ticket is still at intake. Before today the landlord hadn't been contacted in writing since 18 Aug.

The landlord hadn't been contacted in writing since 18 Aug, so I chased him myself as well as escalating.
